question: Who among the following Indian classical tabla players was called ‘Abbaji’'? He collaborated with American jazz drummer Buddy Rich to create a music album in 1968.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alla Rakha.** __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alla Rakha:-**

 
 
• He is also known as A.R. Qureshi, was born in 1919 in Phagwal, Jammu, India.
 
• **He was a renowned tabla player of the Punjab gharana (community of musicians sharing a distinctive musical style).**
 
• He was also a devoted teacher and founded the Alla Rakha Institute of Music in Bombay in 1985.
 
• **The Indian classical tabla player who was called ‘Abbaji’ and collaborated with American jazz drummer Buddy Rich to create a music album in 1968 is Alla Rakha.**
 
• Rakha is best known for his collaboration with sitar virtuoso Ravi Shankar in the 1960s and '70s. The duo toured extensively and helped to popularize Indian classical music in the West. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Taufiq Qureshi:-**

 
 
• **Taufiq Qureshi is an Indian classical musician and percussionist. **
 
• He is the son of the legendary tabla player Alla Rakha and the younger brother of Zakir Hussain, who is also a renowned tabla player.
 
 
 
• **Zakir Hussain:-**
 
 
• ** Zakir Hussain is an Indian tabla player, composer, educator, and producer. **
 
• He is widely regarded as "one of the world's greatest tabla players."
 
 
 
• **Fazal Qureshi:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian tabla player and the son of the legendary tabla maestro Ustad Allah Rakha. **
 
• He was born in Mumbai, India, in 1963 and began learning the tabla from his father at a young age.
 
• He also studied under other renowned tabla players, including Ustad Zakir Hussain and Ustad Aashish Khan.
